# Data contracts of the oecd pack

One section per command of the pack: the shape of its data, how it is stored and checked, and what a person still has to confirm. The rules every contract shares are in [the contracts README](../README.md); the index of every command is [packs/README.md](README.md). The pack's guide, [config/packs/economy/oecd/guides/oecd.md](../../../config/packs/economy/oecd/guides/oecd.md), links each kind here and to its example (tools/packgen/common/guide_data.py) next to how to use the pack and where each kind's data comes from (*Data retrieval*).

| Command | Kind | Class | Status | Fields | To review |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [OECD](#oecd-oecd-country-oecd-country) | `oecd-country` | fundamental | active | 15 | 0 |
| [OECDS](#oecds-oecd-series-oecd-series) | `oecd-series` | fundamental | active | 17 | 0 |

## OECD: OECD country (`oecd-country`)

One OECD member: the latest leading indicator, unemployment, inflation and growth, and the members on a map shaded by inflation.

|  |  |
|---|---|
| Contract | [oecd-country.contract.yaml](../../../config/packs/economy/oecd/contracts/oecd-country.contract.yaml) · version 1.0 |
| Class | fundamental |
| Status | active |
| Source | public data: OECD, pulled by the oecd feed (config/feeds/oecd.yaml, tools/feeds/sources/) |
| Grain | One row per oecd country, keyed by COUNTRY_ID. |
| Key | `COUNTRY_ID` |
| Id pattern | `^OECD-` |
| Dated by | `snapshot` |
| Cadence | daily (due: the oecd feed's schedule (0 12 * * * UTC); a pull with nothing new writes nothing and the lake keeps its latest date) |
| Binding hint | lake table `oecd.oecd-country`; the site binds it (`config/bindings.yaml`, Admin → Data bindings) |
| Test data | config/packs/economy/oecd/samples |
| Worked example | [oecd/oecd-country](../samples/oecd.md#oecd-country) (a real record, every field explained, for the production query; tools/testdata/sample_docs.py) |

**Fields**

| Field | Type | Presence | Unit | Description | Example or values | Link |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `COUNTRY_ID` | id | required |  | OECD- and the member's ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code. | `OECD-AUS` (pattern `^OECD-`) |  |
| `NAME` | text | required |  | The member's name as the OECD writes it. | `Australia` |  |
| `ISO3` | text | required |  | The member's ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 code (the OECD's REF_AREA), the key the map shades by. | `AUS` |  |
| `COUNTRY_NAME` | text | optional |  | The member's name as the OECD writes it. | `Australia` |  |
| `LEADING_INDICATOR` | amount | optional | index, long-term average = 100 | The composite leading indicator, amplitude adjusted: above 100 and rising, growth above trend ahead. | `99.9505` |  |
| `LEADING_INDICATOR_PERIOD` | text | optional |  | The SDMX time period of the value (2026-09 a month, 2026-Q2 a quarter). | `2026-09` |  |
| `UNEMPLOYMENT` | amount | optional | % of labour force | The harmonised unemployment rate, seasonally adjusted, ages 15 and over. | `4.718349` |  |
| `UNEMPLOYMENT_PERIOD` | text | optional |  | The SDMX time period of the value (2026-09 a month, 2026-Q2 a quarter). | `2026-09` |  |
| `INFLATION` | rate | optional | % a year | Consumer price inflation, all items, on the same month a year before. | `4.34` |  |
| `INFLATION_PERIOD` | text | optional |  | The SDMX time period of the value (2026-09 a month, 2026-Q2 a quarter). | `2026-09` |  |
| `GDP_GROWTH` | rate | optional | % | Real GDP growth on the previous quarter, seasonally adjusted. | `0.419502713` |  |
| `GDP_GROWTH_PERIOD` | text | optional |  | The SDMX time period of the value (2026-09 a month, 2026-Q2 a quarter). | `2026-Q2` |  |
| `MEASURES` | record list | required |  | Every measure the feed pulled for the member, one row each: MEASURE, TITLE, UNIT, LATEST, PERIOD, CHANGE and OECD_SERIES. |  |  |
| `PROVENANCE` | record | required |  | Where the record comes from, one object: SOURCE, DATASET, RETRIEVED_AT, LICENCE, ATTRIBUTION, URL and INTERNAL_ONLY. |  |  |
| `MEASURE_COUNT` | integer | required |  | How many measures have a value for the member. | `4` |  |

**Nested `MEASURES[]`**

| Field | Type | Presence | Unit | Description | Example or values | Link |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `MEASURE` | text | required |  | The measure's id in the feed's YAML (CLI, UNEMPLOYMENT, INFLATION, GDP_GROWTH). | `CLI` |  |
| `TITLE` | text | required |  | The measure's title in the feed's YAML. | `Composite leading indicator` |  |
| `UNIT` | text | required |  | What the measure is in. | `index, long-term average = 100` |  |
| `LATEST` | amount | required | the row's UNIT | The latest value. | `99.9505` |  |
| `PERIOD` | text | required |  | The SDMX time period of the value (2026-09 a month, 2026-Q2 a quarter). | `2026-09` |  |
| `CHANGE` | amount | optional | the row's UNIT | The latest value less the previous period's. | `-0.04308` |  |
| `OECD_SERIES` | id | required |  | The oecd-series page with the history (OECDS-<ISO3>-<measure>). | `OECDS-AUS-CLI` (pattern `^OECDS-`) | `oecd-series` |

**Nested `PROVENANCE`**

| Field | Type | Presence | Unit | Description | Example or values | Link |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `SOURCE` | text | required |  | The organisation whose published data the record holds. | `OECD` |  |
| `DATASET` | text | required |  | The OECD dataflow the record was built from. | `OECD Data Explorer (SDMX)` |  |
| `RETRIEVED_AT` | date | required |  | The business date of the feed's pull that wrote the record. | `2026-11-06` |  |
| `LICENCE` | text | required |  | The terms under which the source allows reuse, as recorded in the feed's YAML. | `OECD terms and conditions: data may be extracted, copied an…` |  |
| `ATTRIBUTION` | text | required |  | The credit line to repeat when the data is shown or republished. | `Source: OECD Data Explorer (CC BY 4.0).` |  |
| `URL` | text | required |  | The OECD Data Explorer's page for the dataflow. | `https://data-explorer.oecd.org/` |  |
| `INTERNAL_ONLY` | boolean | required |  | True when the source's terms forbid redistribution outside the organisation (Export data refuses the record). | `False` |  |

**Links:** `MEASURES[].OECD_SERIES` → `oecd-series`.

**Validation**

- required: fields `COUNTRY_ID`, `NAME`, `ISO3`, `MEASURES`, `PROVENANCE`, `MEASURE_COUNT`
- unique: key `COUNTRY_ID`; per snapshot
- pattern: field COUNTRY_ID; pattern ^OECD-
- range: field MEASURE_COUNT; min 0
- link: field MEASURES[].OECD_SERIES; kind oecd-series

**Notes**

- Stored in the worldlake lake (config/lakes/worldlake.yaml), table <data>/delta/worldlake/oecd/oecd-country/, one JSONL.gz a business date loaded with mode replace (a rerun of a day is idempotent).
- Delivered as JSON Lines: one document a line, UTF-8, gzipped, with a .ready file naming the lake, pack, kind, connector, business date, mode, key, sha256 and row count (DATA_LAKE_GUIDE.md section 4).

## OECDS: OECD series (`oecd-series`)

One OECD measure of one member by period: the history, the latest value and the change.

|  |  |
|---|---|

| Status | active |
| Source | public data: OECD, pulled by the oecd feed (config/feeds/oecd.yaml, tools/feeds/sources/) |
| Grain | One row per oecd series, keyed by SERIES_ID. |
| Key | `SERIES_ID` |
| Id pattern | `^OECDS-` |
| Dated by | `snapshot` |
| Cadence | daily (due: the oecd feed's schedule (0 12 * * * UTC); a pull with nothing new writes nothing and the lake keeps its latest date) |
| Binding hint | lake table `oecd.oecd-series`; the site binds it (`config/bindings.yaml`, Admin → Data bindings) |
| Test data | config/packs/economy/oecd/samples |
| Worked example | [oecd/oecd-series](../samples/oecd.md#oecd-series) (a real record, every field explained, for the production query; tools/testdata/sample_docs.py) |

**Fields**

| Field | Type | Presence | Unit | Description | Example or values | Link |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `SERIES_ID` | id | required |  | OECDS-, the member's ISO alpha-3 code and the measure's id. | `OECDS-USA-CLI` (pattern `^OECDS-`) |  |
| `NAME` | text | required |  | The member and the measure, as one name. | `United States · Composite leading indicator` |  |

| `HISTORY` | record list | required |  | The value by period, oldest first, over the feed's history-periods (PERIOD, VALUE). |  |  |
